open_points.subject: M10 ManifestOperation vs K-16/M28 instance selection
open_points.text: M10: "each is absent when the installation selects no instance"; K-16/M28: "An installation selects one manifest instance per service" / "service_instances: one selected instance per service".
open_points.question: Can an installation omit an instance selection for a service, or is exactly one instance per service mandatory?
options: Exactly one instance per service is mandatory; missing selection is invalid configuration.
Selection may be missing for some services; related ManifestOperation facts can be absent.
open_points.default_guess: Exactly one instance per service is mandatory; treat missing selection as configuration refusal.

open_points.subject: Kernel action surface for spooled file reads
open_points.text: K-11: "The kernel exposes one fixed set of typed operations ... inspect, author, try, run, resume, read traces, and the owner's approve, accept, activate, grant, revoke, resolve and cancel." M22: "Read by ... `read_spooled_file`".
open_points.question: Is `read_spooled_file` a real product action on the MCP surface, and if so who may call it?
options: No separate action; spooled file access is only through existing actions (e.g., approval preview / trace reads).
Separate owner-and-agent `read_spooled_file` action exists (with K-14 masking for agents).
open_points.default_guess: No separate action; keep surface exactly as K-11 list.

open_points.subject: M18 FlowActivation on repeated activation of the same version
open_points.text: M18: "A flow's active version is the one recorded last ... a new activation replaces the previous one at once"; State 0 action text does not say what happens when the requested version is already active.
open_points.question: If owner requests activation of a flow version that is already active, does the kernel append a new FlowActivation record or return current state without change?
options: Idempotent no-op: return current active version, no new FlowActivation record.
Append a new FlowActivation record even for the same version.
open_points.default_guess: Append a new FlowActivation record even when the version is already active.

open_points.subject: M24 EffectApproval state when run ends before decision/use
open_points.text: M24: "When its run ends, an approval that is still `requested` or unused can no longer be decided or used."
open_points.question: Does run end trigger any status change on such approvals, or do they remain in `requested`/`approved` permanently but become ineligible?
options: No status change; keep `requested`/`approved` and enforce ineligibility by rule.
Auto-transition to an existing terminal status (e.g., `refused`) without owner decision.
open_points.default_guess: No status change; keep existing status and enforce ineligibility by rule.
